admin.face_cleanup_intro_actions_body: Send a face to the person it really belongs to (or a brand-new one), park it as an unknown person, keep it where it is, lock it so no future scan questions it again, or drop it if it isn't a real face at all.
admin.face_cleanup_intro_actions_title: Every face is yours to route
admin.face_cleanup_intro_lead: Face recognition sorts detected faces into people on its own, and it is deliberately cautious about it: a wrong assignment is far harder to untangle later than one it never made. So it leaves the doubtful calls alone. This page is where you make them.
admin.face_cleanup_intro_manual_body: Manual review skips the scan entirely: pick any person and go through their faces yourself, with the same actions. Nothing is written until you press Apply.
admin.face_cleanup_intro_scan_body: Guided cleanup re-checks the library and flags faces that resemble someone else more than the person they're filed under. It changes nothing. You just get the shortlist.
admin.face_cleanup_intro_scan_title: A scan finds the doubtful calls

admin.face_cleanup_manual_review_empty_sub: This person has no faces in their cluster.
admin.face_cleanup_manual_review_help_footer: Locks can be undone from the Resolutions page. If moving or detaching leaves an unnamed person with no faces at all, that empty person is removed.
admin.face_cleanup_manual_review_help_intro: Nothing changes until you press Apply. Unlike guided review, most faces here are expected to stay Keep. You only need to act on the exceptions.
admin.face_cleanup_manual_review_help_keep_bod: The default for every face on this page. There's no button for it, because you never have to select it. Guided review stamps every face with one of six outcomes; here an untouched face is just left as it is.
admin.face_cleanup_manual_review_help_keep_eff: nothing. A kept face is never sent with the Apply request, so nothing is written for it. Most faces in a cluster are already right, and Keep lets you skip them instead of confirming each one by hand.
admin.face_cleanup_manual_review_help_lock_bod: Like Keep, but permanent and independent of the owner. Use it for faces that genuinely don't look like this person: childhood photos, big age gaps, costumes, heavy shadow.
admin.face_cleanup_manual_review_help_move_bod: Send the face to a person you pick: anyone in this library, or a new person you create on the spot. Use it whenever you recognize who a face really belongs to.
admin.face_cleanup_manual_review_help_move_eff: the face moves to your chosen person. Tick "Lock so it won't re-flag" in the picker to make the move durable, so recognition never routes the face back here later.
admin.face_cleanup_manual_review_help_unmark_b: Returns the current selection to Keep. Use it to undo a mis-click before you apply.
admin.face_cleanup_manual_review_help_unmark_e: the mark is cleared. Nothing is sent for these faces on Apply, exactly as if you'd never touched them. It only affects your current selection; every other staged mark is untouched.
admin.face_cleanup_manual_review_move_entire_c: This moves all {count, plural, one {# face} other {# faces}} in this cluster to {name}, including faces you've never loaded or looked at on this page. That is what a whole-cluster move is for, and also its risk.

admin.face_cleanup_review_help_detach_body: The crop isn't a real face: a poster, a statue, a reflection, a blurred smudge.
admin.face_cleanup_review_help_detach_effect: the detected face region is retired for good. It leaves this person, loses its identity link, and recognition never proposes it for anyone again. If it IS a real face, use Unknown person instead: a detached face is gone from face recognition and never comes back into the pool. Your photo is untouched. If that crop was the person's thumbnail, a new one is generated.
admin.face_cleanup_review_help_footer: Declines and locks can be undone from the Resolutions page. If moving or detaching leaves an unnamed person with no faces at all, that empty person is removed.
admin.face_cleanup_review_help_intro: Nothing changes until you press Apply. Every flagged face has to end in one of these six states. Then this person leaves the cleanup queue for good.
admin.face_cleanup_review_help_lock_body: Like Keep here, but permanent and owner-agnostic. Use it for faces that genuinely don't resemble their owner: childhood photos, big age gaps, costumes, heavy shadow.
admin.face_cleanup_review_help_lock_effect: the face is pinned to this person and no future scan can flag it again, no matter who it comes to resemble. The lock survives the person being merged into another or deleted. Undo it any time from the Resolutions page.
admin.face_cleanup_review_help_other_body: Send the face to a person you pick, instead of the one the scan suggested. The picker covers everyone in this library, and can create a new person.
admin.face_cleanup_review_help_other_effect: the face moves to your chosen person. Tick "Lock so it won't re-flag" in the picker when you're deliberately overriding the scan: an age-gap face that doesn't look like the person it truly belongs to. Without it, the next scan can flag the face again and point it back at whoever it resembles.
admin.face_cleanup_review_help_owner_body: The face belongs to the suspected owner the scan found, the person it actually looks like. This is the default for every flagged face; you only need to touch the exceptions.
admin.face_cleanup_review_help_owner_effect: the face leaves this person and joins the suspected owner. It won't come back, because it now sits with the person it resembles.
admin.face_cleanup_review_help_stay_body: The face really does belong to the person you're reviewing; the scan got it wrong.
admin.face_cleanup_review_help_stay_effect: the face stays put and the scan's suggestion is declined, so future scans stop proposing that same move. If a later scan suspects a different person, the face can be flagged again. Use Confirm & lock to silence it for good.
admin.face_cleanup_review_help_unknown_body: It's a real face, it just isn't this person, and you don't know whose it is. Common when you tidy someone else's library: a friend of the family turns up in the cluster and there is nobody to send them to.
admin.face_cleanup_review_help_unknown_effect: the selected faces move into a new unnamed cluster of their own and are locked there, so no future scan re-flags them. They stop polluting this person, and show up as an unnamed person on the People page, where the library's owner, or face recognition suggestions, can name them later. Select every face you believe is the same stranger before you apply: they are parked together, so they can be named in one go.

admin.machine_learning_clip_max_distance_descr: Maximum cosine distance for smart search results. Lower values return fewer but more relevant results. The ideal value depends on your library and CLIP model. 0.75 is a reasonable starting point; if searches return nothing, raise the threshold in small steps until relevant photos reappear. Set to 0 to disable (default).
admin.machine_learning_face_suggestions_settin: Show likely matches on a named person's page for quick review. Turning this on starts a scan of your library.
admin.machine_learning_pet_detection_descripti: Detect cats and dogs in photos (RF-DETR)
admin.machine_learning_pet_detection_model_des: Model used for detecting pets. Nano is faster, Small is more accurate.
admin.machine_learning_pet_detection_setting_d: Enable automatic pet detection in uploaded photos
admin.machine_learning_pet_recognition_descrip: Recognize and group individual pets across photos
admin.machine_learning_pet_recognition_max_dis: Maximum distance between two pets to be considered the same individual, ranging from 0.1-2. Lowering this can prevent labeling two pets as the same individual, while raising it can prevent labeling the same pet as two different individuals.
admin.machine_learning_pet_recognition_min_fac: The minimum number of recognized faces for a pet to be created as a named individual. Increasing this makes Pet Recognition more precise at the cost of increasing the chance that a pet face is not assigned to an individual.
admin.machine_learning_pet_recognition_model_d: Models are listed in ascending order of size. Larger models are slower and use more memory, but produce better results.
admin.machine_learning_pet_recognition_setting: If disabled, detected pets are grouped by species only and will not be recognized as named individuals.
admin.machine_learning_suggestion_max_distance: Maximum embedding distance for a face to show up as a suggestion on a named person's page. Must be greater than the Maximum recognition distance.
admin.memory_person_throwback_dormancy_setting: How many months someone must be absent from your photos before the Person throwback memory can resurface them. Lower values surface more people, including some you still see regularly.
admin.memory_retention_setting_description: Number of days to keep generated memories. Set to 0 to keep memories forever.
admin.memory_theme_max_distance_setting_descri: Maximum CLIP cosine distance for the Themes memory type. Text-to-image distances sit much higher than face or duplicate thresholds, so 0.75 is a reasonable starting point. Lower values are stricter and can produce no themed memories at all. Set to 0 to accept every smart-search result.
admin.memory_type_birthday_setting_description: Generate memories on the birthdays of named people.
admin.memory_type_favorites_throwback_setting_: Generate memories from your favorite photos taken in this calendar month in previous years.

admin.memory_type_on_this_day_setting_descript: Generate memories from photos taken on this date in previous years.
admin.memory_type_people_together_setting_desc: Generate memories of two people or pets often photographed together in a past year.

admin.memory_type_recent_trip_setting_descript: Generate memories from places recently visited away from home.

admin.server_merge_people_across_owners_descri: Let users merge two people that belong to other users, or two people in a shared space they cannot edit, into one. This only affects merges that combine such people; merges that simply re-point a single person to a different identity are always allowed. Each combining merge must be explicitly confirmed, since it deletes one of another user's (or the space's) people and may not be cleanly reversible. When disabled, these combining merges are blocked for everyone.
admin.storage_migration_rollback_description: Enter the batch ID returned when the migration started to roll back all database path changes.
admin.storage_usage_derivatives_refresh_hint: Usage is recalculated once when you change this setting, then kept up to date by the nightly Sync quota usage task. If that nightly task is disabled, only the reconciliation of derivative bytes stops.
admin.storage_usage_include_derivatives_settin: Include cached files in storage usage

Count thumbnails and transcoded videos toward each user's storage usage. The figure users see and the number their quota is enforced against both change, so the two can never disagree. Off by default, like upstream, where only original files count.
